title: Saint Thomas Aquinas, Priest and Doctor of the Church
short_summary: Saint Thomas Aquinas is honored in the Dominican calendar as a priest and Doctor of the Church whose study, teaching, prayer, and love for the Eucharist served the truth of Christ and the good of souls.
key_facts: The Dominican Calendarium keeps Saint Thomas Aquinas as a feast on January 28.
The Order of Preachers identifies him as a priest and Doctor of the Church.
The Order's saints and blesseds page says Thomas was born at Roccasecca in Italy.
Benedict XVI highlighted Thomas's theological wisdom and his Eucharistic soul.
His Dominican feast is shown as a proper observance in the app while the general U.S. calendar remains primary.

sections.heading: Study in service of truth
sections.body: Thomas's theological work belongs to the Church's search for truth under the light of faith. His learning was ordered toward God, worship, and the care of souls.

sections.heading: Faith and reason together
sections.body: Thomas is often remembered for showing that reason and revelation are not enemies. Human intelligence is purified and elevated when it receives the light of faith.

sections.heading: Theology serving worship
sections.body: His teaching did not end in ideas alone. Benedict XVI highlighted the Eucharistic depth of Thomas's faith, reminding readers that theology serves adoration and communion with God.

sections.heading: A Dominican Doctor
sections.body: The Dominican calendar honors Thomas not only as a brilliant teacher, but as a friar whose intellectual life was rooted in prayer, humility, and service.

catholic_connection_sections.heading: Faith seeking understanding
catholic_connection_sections.body: Thomas's witness shows that careful reason and Catholic faith can work together in the service of revealed truth.

catholic_connection_sections.heading: Truth for worship and souls
catholic_connection_sections.body: Catholic theology is healthiest when it leads to worship, conversion, and pastoral care rather than pride or sterile argument.

catholic_connection_sections.heading: Dominican study
catholic_connection_sections.body: In the Dominican tradition, study is a form of service: patient attention to truth so that Christ may be preached faithfully.
